title: Anders Hejlsberg interview transcript notes
desc: Catatan pertanyaan eksplisit dan jawaban dari video Pragmatic Engineer interview dengan Anders Hejlsberg.

pertanyaan-eksplisit-gergely-dan-jawaban.text: Pertanyaan eksplisit Gergely dan jawaban Anders

1-how-did-you-get-into-programming--meni.text: 1. “How did you get into programming?” — menit 1:56–2:48

2-as-a-kid-what-did-you-start-to-program.text: 2. “As a kid, what did you start to program on it?” — menit 3:13–4:20

3-how-did-you-go-from-building-games-to-.text: 3. “How did you go from building games to building your first compiler?” — menit 4:43–6:50

4-at-borland-you-created-turbo-pascal-th.text: 4. “At Borland you created Turbo Pascal, the language and IDE, right?” — menit 6:50–7:45

5-why-was-it-called-turbo-pascal--menit-.text: 5. “Why was it called Turbo Pascal?” — menit 7:45–8:08

6-was-turbo-pascal-popular-because-of-co.text: 6. “Was Turbo Pascal popular because of compiler, or also because of IDE?” — menit 8:08–8:57

7-saat-bikin-compiler-apakah-sudah-mikir.text: 7. “Saat bikin compiler, apakah sudah mikir IDE features seperti editing/debugging?” — menit 9:04–10:14

8-why-do-you-think-turbo-pascal-was-so-p.text: 8. “Why do you think Turbo Pascal was so popular?” — menit 10:14–11:23

9-how-did-ideas-evolve-from-turbo-pascal.text: 9. “How did ideas evolve from Turbo Pascal to Delphi?” — menit 11:23–13:56

10-you-joined-microsoft-in-1996-what-was.text: 10. “You joined Microsoft in 1996… what was the programming environment like?” — menit 13:56–16:03

11-how-did-j-development-go-and-how-did-.text: 11. “How did J++ development go, and how did it lead to doing something else?” — menit 16:03–18:47

13-what-were-your-design-goals-for-c--me.text: 13. “What were your design goals for C#?” — menit 18:47–20:22

14-what-did-it-take-to-build-a-language-.text: 14. “What did it take to build a language like C#?” — menit 20:38–23:45

15-roslyn-meaning-the-compiler-is-in-c-r.text: 15. “Roslyn meaning the compiler is in C#, right?” — menit 23:38–24:46

16-how-did-you-get-feedback-when-buildin.text: 16. “How did you get feedback when building a language?” — menit 27:15–28:17

17-asyncawait-what-did-you-get-right-and.text: 17. “Async/await: what did you get right, and why was it copied?” — menit 28:17–32:44

18-how-did-javascript-explode-in-popular.text: 18. “How did JavaScript explode in popularity?” — menit 32:44–34:11

19-outlookcom-asked-for-scriptsharp-how-.text: 19. “Outlook.com asked for ScriptSharp; how did that become TypeScript?” — menit 34:11–36:57

21-outside-the-type-system-what-made-typ.text: 21. “Outside the type system, what made TypeScript this popular?” — menit 39:24–41:59

22-how-does-the-typescript-compiler-pipe.text: 22. “How does the TypeScript compiler pipeline work?” — menit 41:59–46:58

23-what-would-you-add-to-javascript-if-y.text: 23. “What would you add to JavaScript if you could?” — menit 47:19–49:07

24-what-are-javascripts-strengths-and-we.text: 24. “What are JavaScript’s strengths and weaknesses?” — menit 49:07–51:14
